title: Lycorine suppresses DPP3-mediated Nrf2 signaling, thereby reducing SLC7A11 levels to trigger ferroptosis in colorectal cancer cells.
authors: Sheng, Juan; An, Qixian; Yu, Fubing; Xiao, Yuliang; Ding, Huifeng; Wu, Lijuan; Duan, Guanyu; Yangyin, Tiantian; Chen, Han; Wang, Jia; Yao, Sihan; Zhang, Yinhong
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究石蒜碱通过抑制DPP3/Nrf2/SLC7A11通路诱导结直肠癌细胞铁死亡，属于纯细胞与动物实验，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Colorectal cancer (CRC) exhibits high morbidity/mortality with poor late-stage survival, creating an urgent need for effective therapies. Although lycorine, a pyrrolophenanthridine alkaloid isolated from the traditional Chinese herb Lycoris radiata, has been confirmed to exhibit significant anti-CRC activity. the exact biological mechanism of its action remains unclear PURPOSE: The present study aimed to clarify whether lycorine exerts its anti-CRC effect by inducing ferroptosis in CRC cells (HCT-116 and RKO), and to elucidate its specific molecular mechanism. METHODS: Human CRC cell lines HCT-116 and RKO were used in vitro: lentiviral transfection was applied to establish cell models with DPP3/solute carrier family 7 member 11 (SLC7A11) overexpression or knockdown, and cells were treated with lycorine, nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) activator dimethyl fumarate (DMF), or Nrf2 inhibitor Nrf2 inhibitor (ML385), followed by detection of cell proliferation, apoptosis, invasion, reactive oxygen species (ROS), intracellular Fe(2)(+) level, GSH/GSSG ratio, Malondialdehyde (MDA)level, 4-Hydroxynonenal (4-HNE) level and expression of related molecules. The ferroptosis-dependent effect was verified using inhibitors such as Deferoxamine(DFO). Molecular docking and enzyme activity experiments were conducted to elucidate the interaction between lycorine and DPP3. For in vivo validation, CRC xenograft models were constructed in nude mice, with tumor volume/weight monitored and hematoxylin and eosin (HE) staining, Ki67 Antigen (Ki67) detection, MDA detection, 4-HNE detection and molecular analyses of tumor tissues performed; RESULTS: Our results demonstrate that lycorine significantly inhibits cell proliferation, invasion, and migration, while promoting apoptosis and ROS generation, indicating its effective suppression of the malignant phenotype in CRC. Further studies reveal that lycorine induces ferroptosis in CRC cells. However, overexpression of DPP3 or SLC7A11, or activation of Nrf2, attenuates the anticancer activity of lycorine. Knockdown of DPP3 suppresses the malignant phenotype of CRC cells, an effect that can be significantly reversed by Nrf2 activator treatment or SLC7A11 overexpression. Additionally, SLC7A11 knockdown markedly counteracts the tumor-promoting effects induced by DPP3 overexpression. Molecular docking and enzymatic activity assays confirm the direct binding of lycorine to DPP3. Ferroptosis inhibitors significantly alleviate lycorine-induced cell death. In vivo experiments further validate this regulatory mechanism. CONCLUSION: Lycorine can directly bind to and inhibit DPP3, thereby blocking the Nrf2 signaling pathway and downregulating SLC7A11. This disruption of GSH metabolism leads to the accumulation of ROS and iron overload, ultimately inducing ferroptosis in CRC cells.
abstract_zh: 背景：结直肠癌（CRC）具有高发病率/死亡率，晚期生存率低，亟需有效疗法。尽管石蒜碱（lycorine）——一种从传统中药石蒜（Lycoris radiata）中分离出的吡咯并菲啶类生物碱——已被证实具有显著的抗CRC活性，但其确切生物学机制仍不清楚。目的：本研究旨在阐明石蒜碱是否通过诱导CRC细胞（HCT-116和RKO）中的铁死亡（ferroptosis）发挥其抗CRC作用，并揭示其具体分子机制。方法：体外实验使用人CRC细胞系HCT-116和RKO：通过慢病毒转染建立DPP3/溶质载体家族7成员11（SLC7A11）过表达或敲低的细胞模型，并用石蒜碱、核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）激活剂富马酸二甲酯（DMF）或Nrf2抑制剂ML385处理细胞，随后检测细胞增殖、凋亡、侵袭、活性氧（ROS）、细胞内Fe(2)(+)水平、GSH/GSSG比值、丙二醛（MDA）水平、4-羟基壬烯醛（4-HNE）水平及相关分子表达。使用去铁胺（DFO）等抑制剂验证铁死亡依赖性效应。通过分子对接和酶活性实验阐明石蒜碱与DPP3之间的相互作用。体内验证中，在裸鼠中构建CRC异种移植模型，监测肿瘤体积/重量，并对肿瘤组织进行苏木精-伊红（HE）染色、Ki67抗原（Ki67）检测、MDA检测、4-HNE检测及分子分析。结果：我们的结果表明，石蒜碱显著抑制细胞增殖、侵袭和迁移，同时促进凋亡和ROS生成，表明其有效抑制CRC恶性表型。进一步研究揭示，石蒜碱诱导CRC细胞发生铁死亡。然而，DPP3或SLC7A11过表达，或Nrf2激活，会减弱石蒜碱的抗癌活性。DPP3敲低抑制CRC细胞恶性表型，该效应可被Nrf2激活剂处理或SLC7A11过表达显著逆转。此外，SLC7A11敲低显著抵消DPP3过表达诱导的促肿瘤效应。分子对接和酶活性实验确认石蒜碱与DPP3直接结合。铁死亡抑制剂显著缓解石蒜碱诱导的细胞死亡。体内实验进一步验证了这一调控机制。结论：石蒜碱可直接结合并抑制DPP3，从而阻断Nrf2信号通路并下调SLC7A11。这种对GSH代谢的干扰导致ROS积累和铁过载，最终诱导CRC细胞发生铁死亡。
